akiec.name: Actinic keratoses / intraepithelial carcinoma
akiec.plain_description: A rough or scaly spot can have several causes and needs an in-person assessment.
general_care: Monitor changes using the ABCDE rule: Asymmetry, Border, Colour, Diameter, Evolving.
Avoid scratching or picking.
Use sun protection and take dated photos to track changes.

bcc.name: Basal cell carcinoma
bcc.plain_description: An image classifier may flag a spot for review; only a clinician can assess what it is.
common_signs: A spot that does not heal
A lesion that changes or bleeds
general_care: Monitor changes using the ABCDE rule: Asymmetry, Border, Colour, Diameter, Evolving.
Avoid scratching or picking.
Use sun protection and take dated photos to track changes.

bkl.name: Benign keratosis-like lesion
bkl.plain_description: Some harmless growths can look similar to lesions that need care; ask a clinician if it changes.
general_care: Monitor changes using the ABCDE rule: Asymmetry, Border, Colour, Diameter, Evolving.
Avoid scratching or picking.
Use sun protection and take dated photos to track changes.

df.name: Dermatofibroma
df.plain_description: A small firm bump has many possible causes and cannot be identified reliably from this result alone.
common_signs: May feel firm under the skin
general_care: Monitor changes using the ABCDE rule: Asymmetry, Border, Colour, Diameter, Evolving.
Avoid scratching or picking.
Use sun protection and take dated photos to track changes.

mel.name: Melanoma
mel.plain_description: A classifier flag is not a diagnosis. Arrange prompt review by a qualified clinician.
general_care: Monitor changes using the ABCDE rule: Asymmetry, Border, Colour, Diameter, Evolving.
Avoid scratching or picking.
Use sun protection and take dated photos to track changes.

nv.name: Melanocytic nevus
nv.plain_description: Many moles are harmless, but a changing spot should be checked by a clinician.
general_care: Monitor changes using the ABCDE rule: Asymmetry, Border, Colour, Diameter, Evolving.
Avoid scratching or picking.
Use sun protection and take dated photos to track changes.

vasc.name: Vascular lesion
vasc.plain_description: Blood-vessel-related spots vary in appearance; ask a clinician about a new or changing lesion.
general_care: Monitor changes using the ABCDE rule: Asymmetry, Border, Colour, Diameter, Evolving.
Avoid scratching or picking.
Use sun protection and take dated photos to track changes.
